acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered owner-accepted requirements in the owning spec (application-map-v0, application-navigation-ledger-v0 or application-flow-understanding-v1), with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each.
Missing or unresolvable evidence yields an explicit UNKNOWN, abstention or full-suite fallback, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only, local and offline.
body:
Competitor/source: `rails routes -E` https://guides.rubyonrails.org/routing.html#listing-existing-routes , `react-router routes --json` https://reactrouter.com/api/other-api/dev , Next.js typedRoutes/build manifests https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/typedRoutes .

Gap: static dialect parsing has blind spots (computed routes, engines, plugins), and a missed route is currently invisible.

Proposal: accept a digest-pinned dump file produced by the operator (Corvint never executes the framework). Routes in the dump but absent from the static map become explicit UNKNOWN coverage gaps. Static routes absent from the dump are marked CONTRADICTED. The dump never gains authority. Report: scratchpad appmap-competitive-research.md (2026-10-10 competitive research).
title: appmap: reconcile static route dialects against an operator-supplied framework route dump
